verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a data warehouse platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows Snowflake only as a managed cloud SaaS, with no documented way to install or run the core product on your own infrastructure. Iceberg tables on customer-managed storage and Snowpark Container Services run inside Snowflake's managed service. These are adjacent features, not self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
